description: Source code for SQL parsing, transformation, and validation within the Superset project, including support for sqlglot, Jinja templating, and Kusto KQL.

classes.name: RLSTransformer
classes.description: AST transformer to apply Row Level Security (RLS) rules to SQL ASTs.

classes.name: RLSAsPredicateTransformer
classes.description: Transformer applying RLS as predicates in SQL AST.

classes.name: RLSAsSubqueryTransformer
classes.description: Transformer applying RLS as subqueries in SQL AST.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: Represents a fully qualified SQL table with optional schema and catalog.

classes.name: BaseSQLStatement
classes.description: Abstract base class for SQL statements, supporting parsing, formatting, and transformations.

classes.name: SQLStatement
classes.description: Implementation of BaseSQLStatement for engines supported by sqlglot, with parsing and formatting.

classes.name: KQLSplitState
classes.description: State machine for splitting Kusto KQL scripts, tracking string contexts.

classes.name: KQLTokenType
classes.description: Enumeration of token types for Kusto KQL tokenization.

classes.name: KustoKQLStatement
classes.description: Class representing Kusto KQL scripts, with custom parsing and formatting.

classes.name: SQLScript
classes.description: Represents a script with multiple SQL statements, supporting parsing, formatting, and validation.

classes.name: JinjaSQLResult
classes.description: Holds the result of processing Jinja-templated SQL, including the processed script and referenced tables.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: Helper method to parse SQL script into list of sqlglot expressions, with fallback for backtick identifiers.

methods.name: split_script
methods.description: Splits a script into individual statements.

methods.name: _parse_statement
methods.description: Parses a single SQL statement into an expression.

methods.name: _extract_tables_from_statement
methods.description: Extracts referenced tables from a parsed statement.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Pretty-prints the SQL statement.

methods.name: get_settings
methods.description: Extracts settings (e.g., SET commands) from the statement.

methods.name: is_select
methods.description: Checks if the statement is a SELECT.

methods.name: is_mutating
methods.description: Checks if the statement mutates data (DDL/DML).

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Returns an optimized version of the statement.

methods.name: check_functions_present
methods.description: Checks if specified functions are used in the statement.

methods.name: check_tables_present
methods.description: Checks if specified tables are referenced in the statement.

methods.name: get_limit_value
methods.description: Returns the LIMIT or TOP value if present.

methods.name: set_limit_value
methods.description: Sets or wraps the statement with a LIMIT.

methods.name: has_cte
methods.description: Checks if the statement contains a CTE.

methods.name: as_cte
methods.description: Wraps the statement as a CTE with a given alias.

methods.name: as_create_table
methods.description: Converts the statement into a CREATE TABLE AS statement.

methods.name: has_subquery
methods.description: Checks if the statement contains a subquery.

methods.name: parse_predicate
methods.description: Parses a predicate string into an expression.

methods.name: apply_rls
methods.description: Applies RLS rules to the statement, transforming the AST.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Pretty-prints the statement.
